description: Renames a project (`nome`) and/or archives it (`arquivado: true`) or brings it back (`false`). Archiving deletes nothing: episodes and videos stay, it only leaves the default list on the site (/ania-studio). Free.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.
